title: Old Country Airs
_note: The main story's fifth chapter (decision 0433): Harlow Bridge, from first light in town to Thadeous joining at the ring wall. The brief's ten beats (docs/regions/harlow-bridge.md, 'The main beat'). Morning in town; evening at the Broken Tankard (tankard.ts's meeting, decision 0388) and a night upstairs; the North Lots by day with Obed; back to the Tankard after dark, where Thadeous takes them up; the Watcher at the gap (nl-watcher, with him as a guest, ended by the lullaby); the verse, the stone, the tower clock; the answer; first light, and he joins.

steps.title: Harlow Bridge
steps.objective: Ask someone in the square about the frost.

steps.title: The Broken Tankard
steps.objective: Evening. Go into the Broken Tankard.

steps.title: The North Lots
steps.objective: Go up the Pasture Lane to the North Lots, and look at the ring wall.

steps.title: After dark
steps.objective: Thadeous goes up to the Lots every night. Find him at the Tankard after dark.

steps.title: The gap
steps.objective: Go up to the North Lots with Thadeous.

steps.title: The verse
steps.objective: The gap is clear. Mend it.

steps.title: The hand's gap
steps.objective: Thadeous has gone along to the hand's gap.

steps.title: First light
steps.objective: Thadeous has sat on the wall all night.
